name: Dazaifu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Dazaifu city emblem in navy: an outlined plum blossom of five interlocking rings.
history: Municipal flag of Dazaifu, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1982.

features.role: Dazaifu city emblem — an outlined plum blossom of five interlocking rings
